summary: A cleaned, downloadable CSV of FDA-registered medical device manufacturing establishments sourced from the FDA's public Establishment Registration & Device Listing database. The FDA maintains a searchable, weekly-updated public database of all establishments engaged in medical device manufacture, preparation, compounding, or assembly — both domestic and foreign facilities that distribute devices in the US market. Medical device regulatory consulting firms (Emergo by UL, Registrar Corp, BLA Regulatory) sell access to similar data as part of $5,000-$15,000 consulting packages or proprietary databases. A one-time CSV ($79-$99) of all US-based medical device establishments with facility type, product codes, and registration details targets medical device distributors, quality management software vendors (MasterControl, Veeva), and FDA regulatory consultants prospecting for new clients.

audience.who: Medical device distributors and group purchasing organizations (GPOs) sourcing new manufacturer relationships; quality management system (QMS) software vendors (MasterControl, Veeva Vault QMS, Greenlight Guru) whose sales teams target device manufacturers; FDA regulatory consulting firms (Registrar Corp, Emergo by UL, MCRA) prospecting for compliance clients; medical device contract manufacturers (CDMOs) seeking production partnership leads; and medical device liability insurance brokers targeting Class II/III device manufacturers.

data_wanted: Establishment name, registration number, owner/operator name, establishment type (manufacturer/contract manufacturer/repackager/relabeler/reprocessor/etc), facility address (street, city, state, ZIP, country), device product codes, device class (I/II/III), registration status, initial registration date — sourced from FDA Establishment Registration & Device Listing database, updated weekly, all public FOIA-releasable data.

evidence.source: FDA Establishment Registration & Device Listing — searchable public database updated weekly with all registered medical device manufacturers
evidence.quote: Releasable establishment registration and listing information under the Freedom of Information Act is available by searching the Establishment Registration and Listing database. The database was last updated on May 18, 2026.

evidence.source: FDA downloadable files — the FDA publishes establishment registration files for bulk download
evidence.quote: Establishment Registration and Medical Device Listing Files for Download

evidence.source: Emergo by UL — regulatory consulting firm offering FDA registration services, demonstrating commercial demand for this data from manufacturers seeking compliance partners
evidence.quote: US FDA Medical Device Establishment Registration and FURLS Listing — Emergo by UL can help you navigate the FDA establishment registration and device listing process

evidence.source: Registrar Corp — another regulatory consultancy targeting medical device manufacturers, proving sustained B2B demand
evidence.quote: The Complete Guide To FDA Medical Device Registration & Listing — Owners or operators of establishments involved in the production and distribution of medical devices intended for use in the U.S. are required to register annually with the FDA

evidence.source: BLA Regulatory — highlights FY 2026 registration fees ($11,423/establishment), confirming high-value target audience with budget for B2B purchases
evidence.quote: The establishment registration fee for FY 2026 is $11,423, a 23.1% increase from FY 2025

willingness_to_pay.signal: Medical device regulatory consulting is a high-value B2B vertical — establishments pay $11,423 annually just for FDA registration fees, and consulting firms charge $5,000-$15,000 for compliance packages. A MasterControl sales rep targeting Class II device manufacturers would pay $79-$99 for a filtered CSV of all US-based Class II establishments (approximately 3,000-5,000 facilities) to run a 6-month outbound campaign, as this is cheaper than a ZoomInfo subscription and more targeted than general manufacturing lists. Regulatory consultants prospecting for new clients have similar one-campaign budgets.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + LinkedIn targeting MasterControl, Veeva, and Greenlight Guru sales teams + regulatory consulting firms (Registrar Corp, Emergo, MCRA), Reddit r/MedicalDevices and r/qualityassurance (for device manufacturer angle), medical device industry LinkedIn groups
first_sale_path.angle: "FDA-Registered Medical Device Manufacturers 2026 — US Establishments, CSV" — facility name, registration #, device class, product codes, address, registration date. Angle for QMS vendors: 'Every facility on this list is FDA-registered and manufactures medical devices for US distribution. Perfect for Class II/III device manufacturer outreach.' Launch US-only first (clearest compliance need, domestic sales focus), then offer 'US + Foreign Establishments' as premium SKU. Emphasize public FDA data, weekly-updated source, and compliance-safe targeting.
